_comment: Editable record of photographed stock. `npm run ingest` adds entries for new photos dropped in Desktop/Tour Archive; it never overwrites fields you have edited here.

items.name: Slazenger Wind Shirt, Golden Horseshoe
items.story: Pullover wind shirt in a teal glen check with black knit trim, carrying the crest of the Golden Horseshoe — the Robert Trent Jones course at Williamsburg, Virginia. Sourced a county over from where it was first worn.
details: Woven check shell, knit collar and cuffs

items.name: Masters Collection Quarter-Zip, Peter Millar
items.story: Masters Collection performance quarter-zip by Peter Millar in a clear Carolina blue, with the yellow-map tournament logo at the chest. Grounds-only merchandise — it never retailed outside the gates.

items.name: Peter Millar Club Quarter-Zip, Navy
items.story: Peter Millar quarter-zip in deep navy with a heathered collar lining and an embroidered members' crest dated 1908 at the shoulder. Private-club issue — the quiet kind of provenance.
